articles.title: “I’m very lucky”: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle opens up about their bond as the Edmonton Oilers’ captain breaks records
articles.summary: Connor McDavid, the Edmonton Oilers’ star player and captain, has put his focus on the ice while his wife, popular entrepreneur Lauren Kyle, has been the
articles.body: Connor McDavid, the Edmonton Oilers’ star player and captain, has put his focus on the ice while his wife, popular entrepreneur Lauren Kyle, has been the strongest source of strength and inspiration for him. As the Edmonton Oilers gear up for their clash against the New Jersey Devils after winning in the last few matches, Lauren Kyle has opened up about their marriage.Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle opens up about how the two support each other through their busy careersIn an interview, Connor McDavid’s wife, popular interior designer Lauren Kyle said, “Yeah. First off, I would say Connor and I are just like our biggest cheer cheerleaders for each other. So like very lucky to have that. And he just wants me to succeed as much as I want him to succeed. And I think when I think of like the community and space, I really separate it completely.”Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle also reflected on the community that hockey has been able to build among women as she said, “Yeah. I think that everyone has their own journey and whether that looks like, killing it as a mom, which there's so many girls that I look up to. Yeah. When I think of, how they're showing up for their families it's very inspiring in its own way. So I show up in a group, like I would show up even if I didn't have any of these businesses.”The popular entrepreneur added, “I think what goes along hand in hand with, my personality is I'm an entertainer. And in that sense, I'm a leader on. A team where I want to like, bring people together and I want to create, experiences for everyone to connect because I think that's such an important part of the hockey world.”Lauren Kyle continued, “I think obviously what's going on in the team is important, but everyone and every player is affected by their partners and their partners happiness and what they're going through.”Connor McDavid breaks records as Lauren Kyle cheers him onFor the unversed, Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle manages multiple ventures along but has never shied away from showing up for the Edmonton Oilers’ captain at almost every match.For now, the focus remains on Connor McDavid’s performance in the new season as he remains committed to the team,Connor McDavid became the fastest player in NHL history to reach 30 assists in the new season, achieving the milestone in just 15 games during a 4–1 win against the New York Rangers. He broke Wayne Gretzky's previous record of 16 games set in 1984–85.In his first 15 games, Connor McDavid has piled up 9 goals and 30 assists for 39 points.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: WWE RAW Results & Highlights 02-November-2026:  John Cena returns, Intercontinental Championship Match, and more
articles.summary: John Cena used the Raw ring in Brooklyn to launch the John Cena Classic, but the night also changed hands at the top of the Intercontinental division.
articles.body: John Cena used the Raw ring in Brooklyn to launch the John Cena Classic, but the night also changed hands at the top of the Intercontinental division. Ethan Page beat Chad Gable for the title in the opening match at Barclays Center on Nov. 2. Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn had already traded words ahead of Crown Jewel, Cody Rhodes drew a visit from Randy Orton, and the main event fell apart into a brawl. Here is how the show went, segment by segment.Ethan Page dethrones Chad Gable for the Intercontinental TitleGable started fast, but Page went after his neck and kept the pressure there through two commercial breaks. The champion hit an Angle Slam through the announce table and locked in the ankle lock twice. Page escaped both times. A Chaos Theory only got two when Gable’s neck gave out on the bridge, and a Twist of Fate gave Page his own near fall. Gable tried one more ankle lock, but Page rolled through and sent him face first into an exposed turnbuckle. An Egoplex ended it, and Page left Brooklyn as the new champion.Judgment Day Beat Green, SKY and StrattonThe six-woman tag started with Stratton and Perez trading offense, and Green, SKY and Stratton cleared the ring with dives before the break. Rodriguez then took over with power moves, and SKY dodged an elbow drop to make a comeback. The match broke down into chaos. Green landed the Unprettier on Perez, but Rodriguez pulled her out of the ring to save the pin. Morgan took a superkick from Green, then won it with Oblivion on the WWE Women’s Champion after Rodriguez caused a distraction. Judgment Day took the fall.John Cena announces the John Cena ClassicCena got a loud pop and ran to the ring, where a covered title sat on a pedestal. He announced the Classic for Dec. 14, with a live Raw from Perth followed by a special show from Walt Disney World in Orlando. The new championship looks like the old spinner belt. Cody Rhodes came out as the first entrant, and Cena admitted he was wrong about his earlier doubts on Rhodes carrying the company. Orton then arrived to promise a Last Man Standing win at Crown Jewel, and he brought up his match with Dusty Rhodes.The Vision edge Penta, Evans and Dragon LeeThe Vision used quick tags and an early rush to control the six-man, but Penta and Dragon Lee kept pulling it back with dives and kicks. Late in the match, Logan Paul tried to pass the Money in the Bank briefcase to Theory on the apron, and Penta stopped him. Evans hit a Red Dot on Theory, then dodged a spear from Breakker, who hit the ring post. Reed leveled Penta, and Breakker finally speared Evans for the pin. The Vision now face Evans and Penta for the World Tag Team titles at Crown Jewel.Sikoa and Keys end in a no contest as Reigns gets jumpedRoman Reigns had opened the show by telling Zayn his run was nearly over. The main event never got a finish. Royce Keys controlled most of it, but Solo Sikoa fought back with a hip attack until the 946 ran in and the bell rang for a no contest. The Bloodline hit the ring for a brawl. Reigns dropped Keys with a Superman Punch, then took a chair shot from a masked man who turned out to be Cruz Montana. The 946 beat down Reigns and Jimmy, and Zayn closed the show with a Helluva Kick on the champion.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Dhinidhi Desinghu scripts history with first-ever Indian swimming medal at Youth Olympics
articles.summary: BENGALURU: Indian swimming has a new milestone to celebrate, and Bengaluru talent Dhinidhi Desinghu is at the heart of it.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Indian swimming has a new milestone to celebrate, and Bengaluru talent Dhinidhi Desinghu is at the heart of it. The 16-year-old became the first swimmer from the country to win a medal at the Youth Olympic Games, claiming bronze in the women's 100m freestyle in Dakar, Senegal, on Monday.While Dhinidhi had set her sights on gold and a sub-55-second finish, her podium finish was a historic achievement for Indian swimming. Croatia's Ana Bobanovic took gold in 55.89 seconds, while New Zealand's Alyssa Lawson claimed silver in 56.13 seconds.The performance had been building momentum from the heats. Dhinidhi clocked 56.80 seconds to finish third-fastest overall and become the first Indian female swimmer to qualify for a Youth Olympics final. She carried that form into the final.“I'm very happy but also at a loss for words. In the heats, my timing went below 57. I've never had a time below 57 in the event, and I knew something special would happen," she told TOI.Going into the final, there was a mix of nerves and confidence. The conditions, too, worked in her favour. "Generally, when I swim outdoors, and it's hot and humid, I swim better, because the conditions are similar to what it is back home," she said.The result, however, was initially not quite what she had hoped for. "When I touched the pad and saw the timing, I wasn't very happy. I wanted to win gold and I wanted my time to break 55, but didn’t achieve either. But slowly it sank in – I am India's first swimmer to win a medal at the Youth Olympics and that does mean something special," added the teenager, who trains under Nihar Ameen.The win's significance went beyond the medal itself. Dhinidi believes her podium finish is a breakthrough for women's swimming in the country."I think what makes it more special is that it's a woman who has given India its first medal in swimming in the competition. It will mean a lot for women's swimming because we're not at the same level as the men. This will make it a memorable chapter in women's swimming in our country and help in the growth of our sport," she said.She is the third Indian to reach a final at the competition, after two-time Olympian Srihari Nataraj, who made the final in 2018, and Tirthank Pegu, who is competing in the ongoing edition.But milestones are nothing new to her. Dhinidhi was just 14 when she made her Olympic debut at Paris 2024, becoming the youngest member of the Indian contingent. She had also represented India at the 2022 Asian Games in Hangzhou and the 2024 World Aquatics Championships in Doha.For now, the triumph is still sinking in.“It (medal) will take some time to sink in. After Paris, it took a couple of years to sink in that I was an Olympian. So, it is safe to say this will take a long time to sink in," she signed off.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Knicks’ Tyler Kolek is loving the trust he’s getting from Mike Brown
articles.summary: Coach Mike Brown’s New York Knicks are 3-4 on the season after a workmanlike effort and win over the Brooklyn Nets at Madison Square Garden that led to comme...
articles.body:
Coach Mike Brown 's New York Knicks are 3-4 on the season after a workmanlike effort and win over the Brooklyn Nets at Madison Square Garden that led to comments on Mikal Bridges' recent workload reduction . Brown sent a message to point guard Tyler Kolek about Jose Alvarado's return as the Knicks faced their crosstown adversaries.

Kolek wound up playing five minutes and scoring two points while Alvardo played nine minutes and had a block against the Nets. Kolek's minutes came in the fourth quarter , which showed Brown's trust in him.

"I think it shows his (Brown's) confidence in me," Kolek said in the Knicks' locker room after the game. "I think he has confidence in every game on the roster. "As he's shown, he'll throw any guy in at any time, to do the spark," the Knicks' backup point guard said.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

The Knicks got 22 points from guard Landry Shamet to lead their offensive attack, along with 19 points from Jalen Brunson and 18 from OG Anunoby. Knicks star Josh Hart gave a shoutout to Shamet, Alvarado and Kolek after the win, as New York moved to 3-4 on the season while the Nets fell to 1-6.

New York hasn't exactly started off on the right foot this season, but they're gaining confidence and developing depth as the season has gotten underway. The Knicks will need unexpected contributions this season if they are to repeat as NBA champions, and Kolek sounds like he has the right attitude with the season continuing to unfold in the Big Apple.

articles.title: Seven receptions for Colston Loveland on Monday night
articles.summary: Colston Loveland caught seven of nine targets in Week 8 for 65 yards as the Bears knocked off the Seahawks on MNF.
articles.body:
Chicago Bears TE Colston Loveland caught seven passes for 65 yards against the Seattle Seahawks in Week 8. Loveland, who was targeted nine times, also lost a fumble.

Why It Matters: After doing little the first five weeks of the season, Loveland has turned things around since Caleb Williams returned from injury in Week 6. In Chicago's last three games, the talented tight end has finished with 65, 69, and 65 yards receiving while scoring a pair of touchdowns. He did have a bad fumble that allowed Seattle to temporarily tighten things up late, but that won't adversely affect his usage going forward. Loveland has firmly reestablished himself as a solid TE1.

articles.title: Scottie Barnes rallies Raptors to 125-118 win, handing Clippers their 6th straight defeat
articles.summary: (AP) — Scottie Barnes scored 15 of his 22 points in the fourth quarter, Immanuel Quickley had 27 and the Toronto Raptors rallied for a 125-118 win over the s...
articles.body:
INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Scottie Barnes scored 15 of his 22 points in the fourth quarter, Immanuel Quickley had 27 and the Toronto Raptors rallied for a 125-118 win over the skidding Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.

Toronto trailed by 13 going into the final period, but Barnes hit a turnaround jumper with 2:08 remaining to give the Raptors their first lead as part of a 12-1 run.

RJ Barrett scored 26 for Toronto. Barnes also finished with 15 rebounds and eight assists.

Kobe Sanders had a career-high 26 points for the Clippers, who have dropped six straight games since winning their season opener Oct. 21 against Sacramento.

It was the second game of a back-to-back for both teams. The Clippers were coming off a 124-112 loss at Golden State on Sunday, while the Raptors fell 131-125 at the Los Angeles Lakers .

The matchup lost much of its luster with Raptors forward Kawhi Leonard unavailable because of a left knee injury, delaying his return to Southern California after spending the previous seven seasons with the Clippers (he missed one due to injury).

His largely disappointing tenure ended when the Clippers had to forfeit five first-round draft picks and were fined $30 million for circumventing salary cap rules in regard to how Leonard was compensated. Team owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year .

Leonard was traded back to Toronto in September for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two first-round draft picks, two second-round picks and a pick swap nearly three months after the deal was originally agreed to in July. It had been delayed pending resolution of the NBA's investigation.

Dick made his first start for the Clippers and had 12 points, four rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.

Clippers coach Tyronn Lue was on the floor despite an illness that prevented him from holding his pregame news conference. Lue had been called a game-time decision by a team spokesman.

Clippers: Host Miami on Wednesday night.

articles.title: Blackhawks share Patrick Kane injury update after Avalanche game
articles.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks had a rough night on Monday. Apart from suffering a 5-2 loss at the hands of the Colorado Avalanche at United Center in Chicago, the B...
articles.body:
The Chicago Blackhawks had a rough night on Monday. Apart from suffering a 5-2 loss at the hands of the Colorado Avalanche at United Center in Chicago, the Blackhawks also saw franchise legend Patrick Kane , who returned to the team on a two-year deal , leave the game in the second period with an apparent injury.

Here is a video of the future Hockey Hall of Famer exiting to the locker room .

The Blackhawks later posted on X (formerly Twitter) that Kane was ruled out for the rest of the game .

In a later update, Chicago head coach Jeff Blashill said that Kane will miss the next two Blackhawks games with an upper-body injury, via Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times.

Patrick Kane, who is the all-time leader in NHL assists among US-born players , only had 10:20 of ice time against the Avalanche, who overcame an early multiple-goal deficit to defeat Chicago.

The Blackhawks scored the first two goals of the game on even strength, with Wyatt Kaiser and Roman Kantserov, in the opening period before the Avs woke up and responded with five unanswered goals, including one on the power play.

The loss to the Avalanche was Chicago's third straight and the last game before the Blackhawks hit the road for a three-game trip away from the Windy City. Given the most positive timeline Blashill has provided, it will be interesting to see whether Kane joins the team on the road to play the final leg of that matchup.

The Blackhawks will next play the Florida Panthers on Wednesday at Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise before taking on the Tampa Bay Lightning at Benchmark International Arena in Tampa on Thursday. The last game of that road trip will be against the Carolina Hurricanes at Lenovo Center in Raleigh on Saturday.

articles.title: Robert Wright III Scores 33 as No. 25 BYU Defeats Ohio State 94-83 in Season Opener
articles.summary: The preseason All-American fueled a dominant second-half surge, shooting 60 percent from the floor to erase an early deficit and power the Cougars past the B...
articles.body:
Rob Wright Ill opened his season with a bang, scoring 33 points to lead the No. 25 BYU Cougars to a 94-83 win over the Ohio State Buckeyes on Monday night at the Delta Center. The preseason All-American shot 60 percent from the field, including 4 of 5 from 3-point range, and added five assists with just one turnover.

The Cougars (1-0) rallied from an early deficit to secure the season-opening non-conference victory. BYU overcame a sluggish start offensively after making just three of its first 13 field goal attempts, including only a single three-pointer.

The Buckeyes (0-1) maintained their lead for much of the first half, taking a 37-34 halftime lead. They built an early 22-11 advantage behind strong shooting from Amare Bynum. The trio of Bynum, John Mobley and Justin Pippen each scored eight points for OSU in the first half.

Wright led BYU with 14 first-half points, while Tyler Betsey added eight of his own. After falling behind, Kevin Young's team had to stage a comeback. The Cougars wasted little time taking control after the break, opening the second half with a 7-0 run to grab a 41-37 lead. Wright continued attacking the basket, reaching 20 points with 16 minutes remaining.

Ohio State responded behind Bynum, who knocked down a 3-pointer and added a transition dunk to help keep the Buckeyes within striking distance. Pippen later tied the game at 52, and the teams continued trading baskets.

With the score tied at 59, BYU delivered the knockout blow, going on a 13-2 run to take a 72-61 lead with just over seven minutes remaining. Ohio State struggled to regain momentum as Mobley fouled out with five minutes left. Pippen also exited.

BYU maintained the lead down the stretch with a solid effort from Collin Chandler. The Kentucky transfer finished with 15 points, matching Betsey's total to go along with six rebounds. Bruce Branch Ill added 12 points, while Jaxon Kohler contributed 11 points and six rebounds of his own.

What's impressive is that BYU shot 69 percent from the field. They also found its rhythm from long distance, making seven 3-pointers in the second half.

Bynum led Ohio State with 20 points, while Mobley scored 14 and Andrija Jelavic added 13. Although BYU's defense showed room for improvement, Young said they were "more good than bad" on that end of the floor. They held the Buckeyes to 9 of 28 (32%) from beyond the arc.

Wright's night offered a glimpse of his potential as one of the nation's top players. He'll be called upon to be BYU's floor general this season.

The Cougars have a few days off before facing Omaha on Saturday, Nov. 6 at 9 p.m. ET on ESPN+.

articles.title: Norfolk State defeats Regent 68-45
articles.summary: (AP) — Bahsil Laster’s 18 points helped Norfolk State defeat Regent 68-45 in a season opener on Monday night.Laster had seven rebounds for the Spartans.
articles.body:
NORFOLK, Va. (AP) — Bahsil Laster's 18 points helped Norfolk State defeat Regent 68-45 in a season opener on Monday night.

Laster had seven rebounds for the Spartans. J.C. Riley scored 12 points while going 5 of 6 and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line, and added seven rebounds. Jordan Skyers had 11 points and shot 5 for 11, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc.

Chase Mullen led the way for the Royals with eight points, six rebounds and three blocks.

Both teams play again on Wednesday. Norfolk State hosts Randolph and Regent travels to play Old Dominion.

articles.title: Knicks Notes: Mike Brown not hesitating to sit Mikal Bridges; Jordan Clarkson providing spark
articles.summary: If Mike Brown thinks someone else gives the Knicks a better chance to win on a given night, he won’t hesitate to sit Mikal Bridges.
articles.body:
Mikal Bridges was 1-for-7 in the third quarter on Monday and the Knicks were struggling. Some NBA head coaches would stick with their veteran in that spot. It's easier to keep a player like Bridges - one who is signed to a large contract and was obtained for significant trade capital - on the court.

But in this respect, Mike Brown isn't most coaches. He didn't hesitate to bench Bridges in the second half of the Knicks' win over the Nets .

We're seven games into the season. Brown has pulled Bridges in the third quarter of three of those seven games.

"Yeah, he's just got to keep playing. Everybody goes through those ups and downs throughout the course of the season, and obviously, it's the beginning of the season right now, so he's got to find his way," Brown said after New York's win over Brooklyn. "Not just with him but with everybody, when you're in a funk you gotta find one or two things to hold your hat on. Mikal is one of the best runners in the NBA.

"In both directions - offensively and defensively. So he's just got to try to hang his hat on that as well as his cutting and trying to do the other little things - rebounding and driving and touching the paint and spraying it. Then this shot will come eventually."

Bridges is shooting 30 percent from the floor so far this year. If you've watched the Knicks during Bridges' tenure, you know that he can be up and down over the course of the regular season. And you also know he can deliver in big playoff situations. Brown believes Bridges will ultimately be fine.

"It's a matter of time in my opinion, before Mikal gets going," Brown said.

But if the Knicks head coach thinks someone else gives the team a better chance to win on a given night, he won't hesitate to sit Bridges.

After a sluggish three quarters, Brown turned to Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek to start the fourth quarter. Clarkson, Kolek, Josh Hart , OG Anunoby and Karl-Anthony Towns sparked the Knicks early in the fourth.

It was the second time in the past three games that Clarkson helped turn things around. The veteran had 18 points in New York's comeback win in Chicago. But he has also basically been out of the rotation in three of New York's seven games.

"I think it shows his character more than anything else. He's someone that if he was on a different team, he could play 20, 25 minutes every night. He could score double digits. He could be that spark, that microwave off the bench. And he's here," Hart said. "He was willing to sacrifice and take a smaller role, be a part of something bigger than himself. So it shows its character.

"It shows his professionalism. To be able to go out and do those things. And when he's not doing it, he's out there coaching, not on the court, he's coaching guys up, talking to them, letting them know what he sees. So he's the ultimate professional. He's someone that you want on your team. And whenever he's given an opportunity, he'll go out and play well."

Brown also had effusive praise for Clarkson.

"You have a veteran that's been there, done that. and he's willing to accept the role that most guys wouldn't accept - even guys younger that haven't proved as much as he's proven in this league. And he's willing to accept it," Brown said. "So, in my opinion, if he's willing to accept it, which is what he did last year, and still try to uplift everybody, connect everybody while he's going through what he's going through, then everybody else should. That's that's the ultimate team player, I will say this about JC. I've been around some good teammates. He's got to be the best. He is the definition of ultimate pro."

Additionally, Landry Shamet led the team in scoring with 22 points off of the bench in 29 minutes. The veteran shot 4-for-6 from three, 6-for-8 from the field, and was a perfect 6-for-6 on free throws.

articles.title: Sam Darnold under duress in uninspired Week 8 performance
articles.summary: Sam Darnold completed just half of his 34 passes and finished with less than 200 yards through the air for the third time in his last five games.
articles.body:
Seattle Seahawks QB Sam Darnold connected on 17 of his 34 passes for 188 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in a Week 8 loss to the Chicago Bears . Darnold also ran twice for 20 yards.

Why It Matters: Playing behind a reworked offensive line, Darnold was under pressure from the get go on Monday night, and he took some big hits early on. The USC alum had his moments, most notably a 43-yard touchdown strike to Jaxon Smith-Njigba right before halftime, but was mostly underwhelming as Seattle dropped to 4-4. The Seahawks need more from the ground game, and you'd imagine the offensive line will improve as it gets more reps as a unit, which should position Darnold for better results. Whether any of that will allow him to move beyond fringe QB2 candidate remains to be seen.

articles.body:
The 2026 Grand Slam of Curling series continues this week with the GSOC Masters from Alberta.

Based on the opener three weeks ago in Victoria, the teams to beat in Medicine Hat will be Team Schwaller on the men's side and Team Einarson on the women's. It was the second GSOC win for Yannick Schwaller and the seventh for Canadian stalwart Kerri Einarson.

Everyone will be gunning for those two teams, but there are plenty of other contenders including two other Canadian favourites in defending champions Team Dunstone in the men's division and Team Homan on the women's side.

Here's all you need to know to watch all the action this week.

Live streams: Fubo , Sportsnet+, Rock Channel
